messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up — after the tag-normalization job ran on candidate metadata last night, we've got ~70 candidates where interviewer assignments disappeared. Not a showstopper yet (they're still in ATS) but no one is linked in the calendar or scorecards. I'm opening an incident ticket. @Priya @Jamal

Priya (Talent Systems): Thanks Ava. Do you have example candidate IDs? Which job/source did these come from? legacy CSV import?

Ava (People Ops): Examples: CND-1123, CND-1145, CND-1199. They all came from the "legacy_import" bucket. Quick root cause hypothesis: the normalization step converted "panel_owner" -> "panel-owner" and our webhook mapping expects the underscore form.

Jamal (Recruiting Ops): Ack. I dug into the pipeline logs — normalize_tags replaced underscores with hyphens across the board. We never added a compatibility layer in src/integrations/ats/webhook_adapter.py for older keys.

Ethan (SRE): If mapping mismatch is the culprit, we can run a safe backfill to re-link assignments. Recommend a dry-run first to list affected interviews, then a targeted fix.

Ethan (SRE): ```bash
# dry run to list affected candidates
python tools/ats_backfill.py --dry-run --filter "source=legacy_import" --check=panel_owner
```

Ava (People Ops): Can you surface the list so we can proactively message hiring managers? We have a 4pm interview for CND-1145 and don't want surprises.

Priya (Talent Systems): On it — I've scheduled a 15:00 dry run and will DM the list to hiring managers + recruiting leads. Also re-opening the mapping PR to add a normalization whitelist so keys like "panel_owner" are preserved.

Lila (Hiring Manager): :worried: Any chance calendar invites were deleted? I have a 16:00 with CND-1145.

Jamal (Recruiting Ops): No deletions — calendar invites exist but the scorecard owner field is blank. We'll attach the owner and update the scorecard metadata, then patch invites so attendees see the right interviewer. ETA ~30m.

ats-bot: Incident INC-2026 created by Ava: "ATS tag normalization -> missing interviewer assignments". Status: triaged.

Ava (People Ops): :thumbsup: Thanks. Please also add a regression test in CI that asserts mapping survives underscore/hyphen normalization.

Priya (Talent Systems): Will add a unit test + a small migration script to remap the tags for legacy_import customers. I'll post the PR link here when ready.

Ethan (SRE): Quick follow-up — I pushed a hotfix branch to integrations, will canary deploy to staging in 10m and roll to prod after verification (target +1h). I'll post logs. :eyes:

Jamal (Recruiting Ops): Thanks team. I'll coordinate outreach to affected hiring managers and confirm when scorecards are patched.

Ava (People Ops): Closing loop: once backfill + tests are in, let's add this to the postmortem checklist so future normalization jobs are gate-checked.
